Original instructions execute in isolated Unicorn memory. OS heap/pools,TLS,locks,clock,COM,thread/event transport and callback interface methods are supplied; no original game process or physical audio device.

Native numeric API AEA880 is used with the original event ID from the bank. No fabricated event string or claim that7067B0 was executed in this revision. Temporary route executes the native706600 factory; bound wrapper storage and registration request are supplied.

Selected media contain two markers at sample0 each. These exact payloads flow through native AF4D50 to callback4; no interpretation of text Tempo/Timestamp as gameplay semantics. AF4C80/B37510 and nonzero marker timing remain unqualified dynamically.
Rust tests invoke actual callback/pool methods with native notification types as inputs. This is consumer comparison, not a Rust marker producer, decoder, scheduler or physical backend execution.
The one disabled-flag native case and three local consumer limits are distinct. No new OOM, streaming/IO,pool19,concurrency or full-loop qualification.
Current client AmbientRequests diagnostic reports backend_available=false. This static boundary is not a new client execution.
